evidence.dom: 【2026-07-29 v9.9.41再監査 → 70を維持(上位N社の構造を追記して補強)】自社シェア: パッシブセーフティ(エアバッグ・ステアリングホイール・シートベルト)のグローバルシェア 約44%。原文「Autoliv is the clear market leader in passive safety components and systems for the automotive industry with an estimated global market share of around 44%」「The Company estimates that its global market share was unchanged at around 44% in 2025 compared to 2024」。製品別では「In seatbelts, Autoliv has a global market share of around 45%」「Autoliv holds a leading position in both airbags and steering wheels, with a combined market shares of around 44%」。市場規模も開示「the annual passive safety market (seatbelts and airbags, including steering wheels), is expected to grow from around $24 billion in 2025 to almost $26 billion」。上位N社合計シェア: 競合の実数は非開示。ただし残る約56%の構造を原本が明示している —— 「We consider Joyson Safety Systems, a part of Ningbo Joyson Electronic Corp., and ZF LIFETEC, a part of ZF Friedrichshafen AG, to be global competitors to Autoliv. In addition, there are several smaller regional and product specific competitors, especially in China.」「In Japan, Brazil, South Korea, and China, there are a number of local suppliers that have close ties with the domestic vehicle manufacturers. For example, Toyota uses "keiretsu" (in-house) suppliers Tokai Rika for seatbelts and Toyoda Gosei for airbags and steering wheels… Mobis, a major supplier to Hyundai/Kia」「BYD has a uniquely high degree of vertical integration…supplied by its subsidiary FinDreams Technology」「Particularly in China, South Korea, and Japan there are numerous domestic competitors often supplying just one OEM group」。=グローバル競合2社(ZF LIFETEC/Joyson)＋系列内製(Tokai Rika/Toyoda Gosei/Mobis/FinDreams)＋中国の多数の地場勢に分散しており、上位2社合計が80%に達する複占(→85)は成立しない。自社44%＋次点が36%以上でなければ複占にならないが、残り56%がこれだけ細分化されている以上その構造は否定される。→ 自社シェア44%(10-K・会社推定、シートベルト45%/エアバッグ+ステアリング44%) / 上位2社合計<80%(複占を構造で否定)・上位3社は実数非開示だが3社寡占でも刻みは同じ70 → 寡占40-69%に該当 → 刻み70。出典: SEC 10-K FY2025 (Autoliv, Inc., CIK 1034670) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1034670/000119312526058162/alv-20251231.htm Item 1 Business『The Company's competitors』/ Item 7『CHANGES IN COMPETITIVE AND CUSTOMER LANDSCAPE』/ Item 1『NEW COMPETITION』
